title: ia read prints the body behind a locator
summary: New ia read <locator> prints only the body behind a locator: a record's own text by its identity (its says, or a system's describes), a cell by identity#phase/Primitive, a requirement by identity#REQ-ID, or the innermost record holding a source line by path:line. --json prints {version, identity, fragment, source, digest, body}, with the record's per-record source digest. A malformed locator is refused with exit 2, and a locator with nothing to read behind it with IA-DB-SOURCE-UNAVAILABLE and exit 1; each refusal names the next command. read is a consumer command, not a machine operation. `@inventarch/runtime` exports parseLocator and readBody, which read through a database handle and an optional scope token and return {identity, fragment, body, digest, source}.
